verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a first-party scheduling capability: schedules map coverage needs and determine who is notified (docs-12). Escalation policies route incidents to schedules (docs-37), mobile schedules exist (docs-91), and a Shift Agent coordinates schedule changes and finds replacements (docs-58). However, the pack never explicitly evidences rotations, layers, time-zone handling, or round-robin coverage, and community feedback calls calendar overrides clunky (comm-4). missing for 10: documented rotation/layer configuration, time-zone support, round-robin coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of schedule flexibility
